sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 544 was established by Ordinance No. 23835, passed by the Dallas City Council on March 24, 1999. Ordinance No. 23835 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 544 is established on property generally located on Tremont Street, beginning at a point 249.99 feet southwest of the southwest line of Paulus Avenue. The size of PD 544 is approximately 0.766 acres. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all code references are to Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 544A). In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this article and the development plan, the provisions of this article control. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.105. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The uses permitted in this district are those uses permitted in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District, as amended, subject to the same conditions applicable in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District, as set out in the Dallas Development Code, as amended. For example, a use permitted in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District by specific use permit (SUP) only is permitted in this planned development district by SUP. A use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the TH-1(A) Townhouse District is subject to DIR in this planned development district, etc. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.106. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific types of accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A- 4.217. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.107. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations contained in Division 51A-4.400. In the event of a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) Front, side, and rear yard. Minimum front, side, and rear yard setbacks are as shown on the development plan.

(b) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units permitted on the Property is 12.

(c) Floor area. No maximum floor area ratio.

(d) Height. Maximum structure height is 36 feet.

(e) Stories. Maximum number of stories above grade is two.

(f) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent for residential structures and 25 percent for nonresidential structures.

(g) Lot size. Minimum lot size is 2,000 square feet.

(h) Minimum lot frontage. Minimum lot frontage must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.108. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) For single family uses, one off-street parking space must be provided per dwelling unit.

(b) For all other permitted uses, consult the use regulations (Division 51A-4.200) for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(c) Consult the off-street parking and loading regulations (Division 51A-4.300 et seq.) for information regarding off-street parking and loading generally. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.109. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Landscaping And Tree Preservation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.110. LANDSCAPING AND TREE PRESERVATION.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) The minimum number of caliper inches of trees to be planted on the Property is 72, and the minimum caliper size per tree is two inches. All species of trees must be from the approved replacement tree list contained in Article X.

(c) The trees required in Subsection (b) above may be located anywhere on the Property, including the adjacent parkway. The planting of trees in the right-of-way is subject to the property owner

obtaining a license from the city to locate the trees in the parkway. The required landscaping must be provided on the Property if the property owner is unable to obtain a license.

(d) Prior to the issuance of a tree removal permit, tree preservation criteria must be met as outlined in Article X.

(e) Plant material must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.111. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Ingress-Egress
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.112. INGRESS-EGRESS.

Ingress and egress must be provided as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Fences
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.113. FENCES.

Fences must be located as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The entire Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this planned development district until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-544.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 544 is located on Zoning Map No. I-8. (Ord. Nos. 23835; 25163)
